requirement: Implement a users list. The Go backend exposes GET /api/users; the browser frontend fetches the response and renders a safe HTML list. Preserve the existing health endpoint.
acceptance: GET /api/users returns application/json with items containing id and name, and total equal to the item count.
The seeded users are Ada (id 1) and Lin (id 2).
The frontend displays every user name and escapes HTML-sensitive characters.
A non-successful HTTP response produces an error instead of a misleading empty list.

contract.summary: Users collection envelope: items and total; backend listens on TEAM_DEMO_ADDR, default 127.0.0.1:8080.

frontend.task: Implement loadUsers(baseURL) and renderUsers(users) in frontend/users.mjs. loadUsers returns the validated response envelope and throws on unsuccessful HTTP responses. renderUsers returns a ul/li HTML string and escapes names. Wire the existing index.html. Use no external packages.

backend.task: Implement GET /api/users in backend/main.go using the standard library, returning the exact seeded users from the contract with JSON content type. Preserve /health and TEAM_DEMO_ADDR. Serve ../frontend as static files at / so the browser uses the same origin. Add local tests if useful.
